package position

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// DeletePosition deletes a position.
type DeletePosition struct {
	Positions repository.PositionRepository
}

// Handle deletes a position by id.
func (uc DeletePosition) Handle(ctx context.Context, id int) error {
	return uc.Positions.Delete(ctx, id)
}
